Chapter 7186: Hard Head

Chapter 7186: Hard Head

“Bam!” Desolate Ancestor was sent flying through dimensions.

When she stood up, her body nearly crumbled with blood soaking her dress.

“Not bad, surviving one move from me.” Heavenfall walked out of the shattered dimension and made Heavenfall sink lower.

He was once thought to be a worthy challenger to the high heaven. Although An Ran, Octopus, and Hidden Immortal ranked higher, his incredible aura didn’t decrease.

“Buzz.” The primordial tree appeared behind her again and bathed her in healing light.

“Clank!” She raised her saber fearlessly again.

“Courageous.” Heavenfall posed with both hands behind his back: “But you can’t stop me, the next move will be the last.”

He spoke in a friendly tone but everyone knew better and retreated from the battlefield.

She didn’t respond, only intensifying her saber intent.

“Buzz.” Someone appeared and stopped her - Li Baye.

“Leave it to me.” He was always shrouded in primordial light as if he was the source.

Desolate Ancestor listened and searched for other enemies.

“Enlightener, Eternal Sacred Teacher...” An immortal said.

No one remembered his name, only his achievement and majestic titles.

Because the waves of tribulations have weakened, he no longer needed to focus on refining them.

“Eternal Sacred Teacher, you’re his manifestation?” Heavenfall asked.

“I am me, no relation to anyone else.” Li Baye waved dismissively.

“Very well, let’s see how much power you have compared to him.” Heavenfall focused his energy, causing cracks to appear everywhere.

“You’re overthinking it, I’m just a lazy fellow who picked up a few tricks, no need to compare anything.” Li Baye said.

“I’ll test your primordial dao then, to see if you are qualified to fight me.” Heavenfall said.

“Primordial dao? Just a few self-defense techniques.” Li Baye said.

While Heavenfall was serious, Li Baye acted as if he were messing around.

“Rumble!” Heavenfall summoned his dao - a gray halo crushing everything with its weight. Nothing was left around him.

“So strong.” Even a primordial immortal shuddered.

This could instantly pulverize any of the nine major worlds.

“Heaven falls from my dao!” He shouted.

The halo came crashing down, obliterating planets and stars along the way.

“My dao?” Li Baye checked inside his pockets and couldn’t find anything: “Shit, no dao, only my head.”

Having said that, he smashed his head against the halo.

“What?!” Spectators became slack-jawed. Any of them would have used their strongest dao and weapons. In this case, Li Baye used his head - the most vulnerable body part.

They imagined that his head would explode into bloody mist. However, the halo was crushed and Heavenfall staggered backward.

“Shit, shit, it hurts so much.” Li Baye rubbed his head while cursing. It looked as if he had a horn on his head.

Others became frozen while staring at him.

“Ho-how can this be?” An immortal couldn’t believe it. Alas, everyone saw it with their own eyes.
